title: Joint continuation preservation in a bounded Lean proof-preview interface

scope.primary: Finite recurrent memory and activation-compression pilot on public proof-preview histories.
scope.architecture: Standalone shared GRUCell. This experiment does not use or replace the LR-01 TypedLoop architecture.
scope.proof_depth: Longer Horn chains exercise certificate generation; the neural interface omits chain structure, so no proof-depth reasoning claim is licensed.
scope.safety: Unauthorized submission attempts and provenance recovery. The host rejects unauthorized proofs; successful unauthorized release is a distinct expected-zero invariant.
scope.formalization: Exact finite reference computations and Lean checking of selected Horn proofs; the general quotient theorems are not formalized by this pilot.

status_semantics.valid: Original host theorem has the root fact.
status_semantics.dead: No root fact; preview remains open.
status_semantics.tainted: Preview claims closure under an external root that the original host never imports.

environment.scored_policy: Two registered probe actions followed by one model branch/STOP decision.
environment.target: Original host atoms, facts, Horn rules, goal and trust policy are fixed and hash bound.
environment.target_action: Smallest valid branch index, otherwise STOP; certified completion also accepts any valid branch.
environment.axioms: No extra axioms for synthetic Horn certificates.
environment.negative_outcome: STOP with no valid branch is correct abstention; unsuccessful or exhausted search is unresolved, not a proof of falsity.

data.status_tuples: All nine ordered status pairs, balanced.
data.fit_boundary: Train only for weights, codec fitting and PCA. Dev only for eligibility, with no checkpoint selection or hyperparameter tuning. Held-out evaluation runs after checkpoint hashes are frozen.
data.independent_units: Report all certificates and per-case rows, nine status combinations, and distinct full F9 input sequences (up to eighteen per two-depth split). Average exactly over distinct full-input patterns, retaining per-status and per-depth breakdowns. Duplicated renamings never count as independent statistical samples.

codec.insertion: After every shared recurrent call; reconstructed state is the next call input.

arms.causal: Common loss + 0.5 one-step closed-loop commutation MSE + 0.25 paired-donor continuation task CE.
arms.joint: Causal loss + 0.5 audit CE + 0.25 paired-donor continuation audit CE.
arms.pca: Train-only rank4 projection with train mean.
arms.random: Seeded orthonormal rank4 projection with train mean.
arms.compact_transition: GRUCell input9/state4, two calls per observation, decoder4to32 into frozen teacher task/audit heads; 300 steps, task CE + 0.5 audit CE + 0.25 teacher hidden-trace MSE. Source encoder and teacher GRU are unused at inference.

controls: Shuffled public observations with the original scoring target retained
neural.counterfactuals: Swap state after first probe with a donor matching the first-probed branch and public depth, then resume the recipient suffix. Every event in a composed history retains that depth. Score against independently composed public history; report both all pairs and status-changing pairs. Counterfactual decisions are separate from original-host proof receipts.
neural.costs: Report state bits, all parameter counts, forward MAC estimates with convention, model time, training time and Lean time. Codec insertion keeps the source GRU and adds overhead; only compact_transition can reduce transition computation.
neural.public_depth_feature: The ninth feature is chain depth divided by eight. It is public metadata; the neural model receives no Horn graph structure.

judgment.teacher_eligibility: At least 95% final task accuracy and at least 95% per-branch audit accuracy on train and dev for each seed. Retain all outcomes; any failed seed makes positive preservation claims inconclusive for that seed.
judgment.completion: Independent original-host check and Lean certificate for every selected successful proof.
judgment.violations: Count tainted submits separately from dead-branch rejects and legitimate abstentions.
judgment.audit: Per-branch status accuracy and exact two-branch provenance recovery.
judgment.continuation: Counterfactual action/audit agreement; one-step commutation and same-code future collisions scored separately.
judgment.funnel_gate: Joint improves order_ood exact full-input-pattern task accuracy over task-only by at least 0.05 in each eligible seed, with no increase in tainted submissions and audit exact-match at least 0.95. Report pass/fail/inconclusive; no retuning.
judgment.resource_gain_gate: Compact transition reaches teacher completion within 0.02 in every test family/eligible seed, has no additional tainted submissions, audit exact-match at least 0.95, and lower counted forward MACs. Wall-time improvement must be measured separately.
judgment.baseline: Fixed Lean-native first over branch0 then branch1 on original theorem; source context and candidate terms identical. Actual budget and timing disclosed, no asserted CPU-match.
judgment.no_population_claim: These gates describe this exhaustive finite interface and registered seeds.

failure_policy: Engineering fixes retain failed receipts and explain effects. Protocol changes require a new version and explicit exploratory label; scored held-out results are never used to tune this registration.

amendment.timing: Before neural training and before scored neural evaluation
amendment.reason: Specify generator seeds already chosen by the gym implementer, account for public depth in the nine-feature input, and require donor swaps to preserve public depth. Training parameters, split sizes and decision thresholds remain fixed.
